govt_response.title: UPA report card: farm credit up seven-fold
govt_response.summary: The report card said credit rose from Rs 1,04,500 crore in 2004-05 to Rs 7 lakh crore in 2013-14 and cited 11 crore Kisan Credit Cards.

analysis: The UPA report card put agricultural credit at Rs 7 lakh crore in 2013-14, against Rs 1,04,500 crore in 2004-05, and described the increase as seven-fold. Independent official figures put 2013-14 credit at Rs 7.3-7.35 lakh crore. The 2004-05 baseline differs across series: the Economic Survey's institutional credit figure is Rs 1,25,309 crore, which would imply an increase of about six-fold. On either series the increase is large and close to the reported order of magnitude.
notes: The 'seven-fold' description depends on the report card's Rs 1,04,500 crore baseline. Using the Economic Survey's Rs 1,25,309 crore for 2004-05 gives roughly a six-fold rise. The claim is therefore rounded rather than exact. [ingest: 1 dead evidence link(s) removed]
